title: Power Apps: form fill assistance suggests updates to fields that already have values
summary: The roadmap details and the cited feature documentation check out, and all cited Learn pages opened successfully. The toolbar control's maker-portal path starts inside the app designer without explaining how to reach it; readers need the route through the solution and the app's Edit command.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk and impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans to extend Power Apps model-driven form fill assistance to suggest updates to fields that already contain values, not just empty fields.
claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields.
